verdict.rationale: Mercury ships several built-in background automations: automatic invoices, receipts auto-attached to card transactions, AI-powered bookkeeping automations, and auto-funding rules that a long-time customer independently confirms. Its webhooks and events, API, and CLI can drive custom autonomous jobs from scripts or CI pipelines. However, Mercury offers no native, user-configurable automation or agent scheduler, so custom background automations need external infrastructure, and some payment flows are deliberately gated behind manual approval. Missing for 10: a native rule or workflow builder for user-defined automations, first-party hosted scheduling or background agent execution, and hands-on evidence of autonomous agent-driven automations.
